أنغلق (form VII)

# أَنْغَلِقَ (ʔanḡaliqa) /ʔan.ɣa.li.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْغَلَقَ (inḡalaqa)
# أَنْغَلِقْ (ʔanḡaliq) /ʔan.ɣa.liq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْغَلَقَ (inḡalaqa)
